snippet.title: GRAVEL – King of Buggies DLC Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/gravel-ps4/

Available Now and free to all Season Pass holders.
BUY GRAVEL NOW: http://gravelvideogame.com/buy-now/

The DLC King of Buggies DLC is available now for GRAVEL on PS4! Includes a entirely new career episode and five new buggy vehicles that will make your life a whole lot faster… and bumpier!
